_doc: art_mutate: Mutate: one run changes a segment of the pattern and keeps its identity. Cumulative: each run mutates the result of the last (undo goes back).
_probability: The size of the segment where changes happen, as a share of a phrase.
_random: The share of the segment's notes that change.
_polyphony: The probability that a changed note gets a third or fifth of the scale stacked on it.
_density: The share of the segment's steps that should hold notes: notes are added or removed towards it. Empty: the pattern's own (no notes added or removed).
_length: The probability that a changed note also changes length (one step, two, or up to the next note).
_operations: How a note changes, by weight: another note of the pattern, an octave up / down, a fifth up / a fourth down (when it stays in the scale), a step of the scale, or swapping with another note of the segment.
_intensity_gain: A longer knob turn (intensity 2, 3...) widens the segment and the share of changed notes by 1 + gain x (intensity - 1) (like a longer press).
_phrases: abac: on patterns of two phrases or more only the even phrases (B, C) change, so the pattern keeps an A-B-A-C form; all: any phrase.
_scale_source: The scale for fifths, steps and stacked notes: own, auto (own, or borrowed from another track), or a track number.
_fallback_scale: Without a scale on any track: pattern (the pitch classes the pattern uses) or chromatic.
_range: Semitones the notes may go below the pattern's lowest / above its highest note.
_new_spice: Also roll a new spice pattern; with spice on the track, the mutation goes under it and the new spice on top.
_keep_first_note: Never change the first note of the pattern.
_seed: null: different every time; a number: repeatable results.
